```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches: [trunk]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Run benchmarks
        id: bench
        run: |
          chmod +x bench.sh
          ./bench.sh > bench_results.json
          echo "BENCH_JSON=$(cat bench_results.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit benchmark results
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -B perf
          git add bench_results.json
          git commit -m "Update benchmark results $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)"
          git push origin perf --force-with-lease
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Add step summary
        run: |
          echo "## Benchmark Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```json" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat bench_results.json >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
